column4: {{flagicon|KOR}}{{flagicon|PRK}} South Korea + Chōsen{{notetag|Japan recognizes the Republic of Korea (South Korea) as the government of the entire Korean Peninsula, and for this reason doesn't consider passports issued by the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) to be valid. Instead, Japan uses the term "[[Chōsen-seki|Chōsen]]" to refer to all ethnic Koreans in Japan who hold neither Japanese nor South Korean citizenship.}}
